title: Updates
description: Every updatable part of Cognia in one place: the apps, the extensions, and your plugins and content.
nothingHere: Nothing here can be updated on this device.

groupHint.apps-and-runtimes: The Cognia app on this device, plus the command-line agent.
groupHint.extensions: Installed and updated by your browser, not by Cognia.
groupHint.plugins-and-content: Plugins, skills, and character packs installed into this app.

notInstalledLocally: Not connected. The store lists version {version}.
connectHint: Connect the extension to see the version installed in your browser.
criticalNotice: This is a critical update. You can postpone it, but it cannot be dismissed permanently.
permissionsExpanded: This version asks for more access than the one you have.
breaking: Installing this cannot be undone by going back.
unsigned: This build is not in the signed catalog. Install it only if you trust the source.
ambiguousSource: Cognia could not tell which package manager installed the CLI. Pick the one you used.

error.network: Could not reach the update service.
error.timeout: The update service did not answer in time.
error.signature: This update failed its signature check and was not installed.
error.rollback: The update service offered an older release than one already seen.
error.incompatible: This version needs a newer Cognia than the one installed.
error.permission: Cognia was not allowed to install this update.
error.disk: There is not enough disk space to install this update.
error.store: The store could not start the update.
error.package-manager: Your package manager could not complete the update.
error.unsupported: This device cannot install this update.

interrupted: The last install did not finish. The previous version is still running.

toast.multiple: {count, plural, one {# update is available} other {# updates are available}}

settings.channelDescription: Beta builds arrive earlier and change more often.
settings.backgroundDownloadLabel: Download desktop updates in the background
settings.backgroundDownloadDescription: Only the signed Cognia desktop package. Everything else always asks first.
settings.notifyCriticalLabel: Always tell me about critical updates
settings.notifyCriticalDescription: A critical update is announced on launch even when automatic checks are off. It never blocks the app.
settings.saveFailed: Could not save the update settings: {error}
